# GTA VI Cheats 0.2

Unofficial, offline Flipper Zero reference for GTA VI Story Mode. It lists 18 published button sequences for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. No unpublished placeholders, GTA Online cheats, or automatic console inputs are included.

Choose a platform and open All cheats or a category. Select a cheat for its sequence, effect, unlock requirement, and source. Each compact sequence includes its full D-pad direction legend. A Quick guide / warnings screen is available from the platform and category menus.

The entries are reported in published third-party guides; this app was not used to test them in GTA VI. Reports differ on some unlock details (Max Ammo and Cycle Weather), noted on their respective screens. Do not treat the list as an exhaustive inventory of unpublished cheats. Save first: activating a cheat disables saving and trophies or achievements for the rest of the session. Use Story Mode only. In free roam, open your phone (D-pad Up), hold L1 then press R1 on PS5 or hold LB then press RB on Xbox, and enter the sequence on the D-pad.
